# Git Commits — verify git commit messages for each operation

# Setup: initialize a KB
exec akb init test-kb
cd test-kb

# init seeds no templates: copy the ones this scenario writes pages of.
exec akb template get note --full --examples
cp stdout .akb/templates/note.yaml
exec akb template get adr --full --examples
cp stdout .akb/templates/adr.yaml
exec git add .akb/templates
exec git commit -m 'seed note and adr templates'

# --- Write creates a git commit ---
stdin ../note-input.md
exec akb write commit-note.md

# Verify write commit message
exec git log --oneline -1
stdout 'akb: write kb/notes/commit-note.md'

# --- Append creates a git commit ---
stdin ../append-input.md
exec akb append notes/commit-note.md

# Verify append commit message
exec git log --oneline -1
stdout 'akb: append kb/notes/commit-note.md'

# --- Delete creates a git commit ---
exec akb delete notes/commit-note.md

# Verify delete commit message
exec git log --oneline -1
stdout 'akb: delete kb/notes/commit-note.md'

# --- Verify commit history has all three operations ---
exec git log --oneline
stdout 'akb: delete kb/notes/commit-note.md'
stdout 'akb: append kb/notes/commit-note.md'
stdout 'akb: write kb/notes/commit-note.md'

# --- Write an ADR and verify its commit message ---
stdin ../adr-input.md
exec akb write commit-adr.md

exec git log --oneline -1
stdout 'akb: write kb/decisions/commit-adr.md'

-- note-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Commit Note
summary: Test git commit
tags: test
---
Note content.

-- append-input.md --
Appended line.

-- adr-input.md --
---
type: adr
title: Commit ADR
status: proposed
deciders: team
summary: Test ADR commit
tags: [test]
created: '2026-01-01'
updated: '2026-09-01'
---
## Context

ADR content. Every mutating command creates a commit whose message names the operation and the page path, so the decision produces a write commit of its own. See [[decisions/related-decision]] for the record this one extends.

## Decision

Decided. The decision is written with the same commit message format as a note.

## Consequences

Recorded. The commit history holds one commit per operation.
